### Remarks
The default value retains the declaration; assign an original complete HTTPS callback URL<br>
of at most 512 UTF\-8 bytes to set it, or use [Delete](Meshline.Models.FieldUpdate_T_.md#Meshline.Models.FieldUpdate_T_.Delete 'Meshline\.Models\.FieldUpdate\<T\>\.Delete') to remove it\. Null and empty assignments are invalid\.
